patches.name: Guest session playback host
patches.description: Points the app's production GraphQL API at Podimo's website host (https://graphql.podimo.com/graphql). The Android gateway host (https://graphql.pdm-gateway.com) rejected guest-session playback requests with HTTP 403 in the supplied analysis, while the website host served the app's own guest registration, profile and single-episode playback operations and returned signed full-length audio for Premium-labelled episodes to a fresh, unregistered guest with a FREE subscription. With this patch the app registers its guest session and requests playback URLs through the verified host; transport security, authentication headers, request signing and error handling stay untouched. Staging and localhost routes are not affected.

patches.name: Unlock Premium playback
patches.description: Replaces every Premium button with the app's existing play button and lets its normal play action run for Premium, Premium Plus, Premium-only episodes and exclusive podcasts, including without an account. The app derives the button, the paywall navigation and the playback permission from one user access validator; this patch returns its typed success result at that single boundary, so the episode rows render the standard play button and the play action reaches the app's own signed playback query. The server still decides whether to return a playback URL, and account data, profile fields and subscription states are not modified. The top-left "Start free trial" promotion pill and its sibling upsell labels are hidden with the app's own invisible banner.
